name: MonarchBulkActionBar
title: BulkActionBar
wrapsNative: ViewThatFits of an HStack (wide) or a VStack with MonarchFlowLayout (narrow) of Text, MonarchButton and a Menu with .menuStyle(.button); placed by the app in safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) over a List(selection:)
summary: The bar shown while items are selected: the count, the actions for the selection with a More menu for the rest, and Clear selection, with the count announced.
whenToUse: Under a List or table with multiple selection when several actions apply to everything selected and the count should be visible and announced.
whenNotToUse: For actions on one row, use swipeActions and a Menu on the row (see row-actions-menu). For screen actions unrelated to a selection, use the navigation bar's toolbar. For a single action on the selection in an edit-mode list, a ToolbarItem(placement: .bottomBar) is enough.
api: init(count: Int, totalCount: Int? = nil, actions: [MonarchBulkAction] = [], maxVisibleActions: Int = 3, isBusy: Bool = false, busyActionID: String? = nil, labels: MonarchBulkActionBarLabels = MonarchBulkActionBarLabels(), onClear: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void, @ViewBuilder accessories: () -> Accessories)

init(count: Int, totalCount: Int? = nil, actions: [MonarchBulkAction] = [], maxVisibleActions: Int = 3, isBusy: Bool = false, busyActionID: String? = nil, labels: MonarchBulkActionBarLabels = MonarchBulkActionBarLabels(), onClear: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) where Accessories == EmptyView
struct MonarchBulkAction: Identifiable { init(id: String, title: String, systemImage: String? = nil, isDestructive: Bool = false, isDisabled: Bool = false, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) }
struct MonarchBulkActionBarLabels { var selected: (@Sendable (Int, Int?) -> String)?; var cleared, clear, more, bar: String? }

options.name: count
options.description: The number of selected items. The bar is shown while it is above zero and takes no room at zero.

options.name: totalCount
options.description: The number of items that could be selected, for "3 of 120 selected".

options.name: actions
options.description: The actions. A destructive one uses the danger button variant and the destructive menu role.

options.name: maxVisibleActions
options.description: How many actions are buttons; the rest go into a More menu.

options.name: isBusy
options.description: Blocks every action while the app runs one.

options.name: busyActionID
options.description: The running action shows a progress indicator; the others and the More menu are disabled.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the count, the clear and More titles, the cleared announcement and the bar's spoken name.

options.name: accessories
options.description: Extra controls after the actions, such as a Picker for a property.

states.name: closed
states.description: Nothing is selected: nothing is drawn and the bar takes no room.

states.name: open
states.description: The count, the action buttons, More and Clear selection on a raised surface.

states.name: busy
states.description: With busyActionID the action shows progress and the others are disabled; with isBusy everything is disabled.

states.name: narrow
states.description: When one line does not fit, the count and Clear take the first line and the actions wrap below.

appearance: A raised surface (the surface background role, the medium elevation and the subtle border role) with a 12-point corner. The count is label-size semibold text in the default text role. Actions are small secondary MonarchButtons, destructive ones the danger variant; Clear selection is a ghost button.
platformNotes: The parity map named .toolbar(placement: .bottomBar) with EditMode. A bottom toolbar holds only a few plain items, cannot show the count with the actions and a More menu in Monarch styling, and does not exist on macOS, so the bar is a view the app places with safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) under a List(selection:) in EditMode, or inline above a table. The web toolbar has one tab stop with arrow keys; on iOS each control is its own element for VoiceOver and the system keyboard focus. The web can wait on a promise returned by an action; on iOS the app sets busyActionID or isBusy. Confirmation of destructive actions stays in the app (confirmationDialog). Android uses the same name and options.
accessibility: The bar is a container named "Bulk actions"; the count is read first, then each action, More and Clear selection.
Every change of the count is announced ("2 of 4 selected"), including when the bar first appears, and "Selection cleared" when it closes.
Icons are decorative; every action has a visible title.
Buttons keep 44-point touch targets; a running action keeps its button enabled and reads its progress through MonarchButton.
edgeCases: maxVisibleActions of 0 puts every action in the More menu; a negative value counts as 0.
An action that empties the selection closes the bar and announces "Selection cleared".
The count text uses the English plural-free form "3 selected"; pass labels.selected for languages that need plural forms.

examples.title: With DataTable selection
An action running, with an overflow menu
examples.code:
MonarchBulkActionBar(
    count: 3,
    totalCount: 120,
    actions: [
        MonarchBulkAction(id: "archive", title: "Archive") {},
        MonarchBulkAction(id: "tag", title: "Add tag") {},
        MonarchBulkAction(id: "export", title: "Export") {},
        MonarchBulkAction(id: "delete", title: "Delete", isDestructive: true) {},
    ],
    busyActionID: "archive"
) {}
